master.definition_en: A form of spondylodysplastic Ehlers-Danlos syndrome (EDS) due to variants in the SLC39A13 gene and characterized by the presence of thin and finely wrinkled skin of the hands and feet, hypermobile distal joints, characteristic facial features (downslanting palpebral fissures, mild hypertelorism, prominent eyes with a paucity of periorbital fat, blueish sclerae, microdontia or oligodontia), muscular hypotonia, associated with significant short stature of childhood-onset, ocular findings (myopia and keratoconus) and, more rarely, vascular complications. Mild radiographic changes were observed, among which platyspondyly is a useful diagnostic feature.

master.definition_en: A rare genetic muscular dystrophy characterized by progressive muscle weakness in a scapulo-humero-peroneal and distal distribution, featuring wrist extensor weakness, finger and foot drop, scapular winging, mild facial weakness, contractures of the Achilles tendon, elbow, and shoulder, and diminished or absent deep tendon reflexes. A predilection for the upper extremities has been reported in some patients. Respiratory muscles are spared until late in the disease course. Age of onset, progression, and severity of the disease vary significantly between individuals. Muscle biopsy shows groups of atrophic type I fibers and increased internal nuclei.

master.definition_en: Chromosome 4q deletion is a chromosome abnormality that affects many different parts of the body. People with this condition are missing genetic material located on the long arm (q) of chromosome 4 in each cell. The severity of the condition and the associated signs and symptoms vary based on the size and location of the deletion and which genes are involved. Common features shared by many people with this deletion includedistinctive craniofacial features, skeletal abnormalities, heart defects, intellectual disability, developmental delay, and short stature. Most cases are not inherited, although affectedpeople can pass the deletion on to their children. Treatment is based on the signs and symptoms present in each person.

master.definition_en: A rare nonhereditary systemic amyloidosis characterized by slowly progressive renal dysfunction, increased serum creatinine, mostly normal urine analysis with no significant proteinuria and associated heart disease. Histology reveals medullar amyloid deposits, renal tubular atrophy, interstitial fibrosis, and glomerular sclerosis.

master.definition_en: An ovarian or testicular stromal tumor characterized by the presence of lipid-rich neoplastic spindle cells. In females, uterine bleeding is the most common symptom. A minority of post-menopausal women with thecoma have an associated endometrial adenocarcinoma or rarely a malignant mixed mullerian tumor or endometrial stromal sarcoma. Rare cases with nuclear atypia and mitotic activity may metastasize. In males, thecomas are rare and they usually present as slow growing, sometimes painful masses. Metastases have not been reported.

curated.name_zh: 阵发性睡眠性血红蛋白尿
aliases_zh: 阵发性睡眠性血红蛋白尿症
curated.category: 罕见造血系统与补体病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 造血干细胞PIGA基因后天体细胞突变（不遗传给子女！）导致红细胞缺少补体保护蛋白（CD55/CD59），在感染、手术等应激下极易暴发急性血管内溶血（酱油色尿）并诱发致命性【不典型部位血栓危机】（如肝静脉血栓布-加综合征、肠系膜静脉血栓、脑静脉窦血栓或急性肺栓塞），血栓占PNH死亡原因的40%–50%，可于数小时至数日内猝死！
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 传统激素与输血仅治标；划时代补体C5抑制剂（依库珠单抗、可伐利单抗）及2024年最新口服近端补体B因子抑制剂（伊普可泮 Iptacopan）可彻底阻断血管内/外溶血与血栓形成，使患者获得接近同龄常人的长期生存期；唯一根治手段为异基因造血干细胞移植（仅限合并重型再障或骨髓衰竭者）。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: Orphanet（ORPHA:447）未单列全球年度死亡总数；在无补体抑制剂时代，PNH确诊后中位生存期仅10–15年（约40%–50%死于血栓）；规范使用补体抑制剂后5年生存率已跃升至90%以上。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国已将该病纳入《第一批罕见病目录》，无单列年度死亡总数；过去因缺药血栓致死率高，2023–2024年多款补体抑制剂落地降价显著改写了国内患者生存曲线。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球超罕见病，患病率约1–2/10万（约10–20/百万），好发于30–40岁青壮年，男女相当。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国年发病率估算约0.1–0.6/10万（全国患者约数千至上万人），常合并再生障碍性贫血（AA-PNH综合征）。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 120一分钟识别与避坑：PNH患者若突然出现剧烈腹痛腹胀、尿量骤减或无尿（急性肾衰/肠系膜血栓）、黄疸迅速加深伴酱油色浓茶尿、突发剧烈头痛偏瘫（脑静脉血栓）或胸痛呼吸困难（肺栓塞），立即拨打120！严禁轻易输注未经洗涤的普通全血或随意大剂量补铁诱发溶血加重；急诊需立即充分水化碱化尿液保护肾功能、评估低分子肝素抗凝，并紧急启动/追加补体C5或B因子抑制剂阻断溶血与血栓瀑布。

standard_drugs.name_zh: 依库珠单抗 / 可伐利单抗
standard_drugs.drug_class: 补体C5单克隆抗体（阻断末端膜攻击复合物形成，终止血管内溶血与血栓）
standard_drugs.usage_role: PNH全球一线标准靶向维持治疗（依库珠单抗每2周静滴；可伐利单抗每4周皮下注射）
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 依库珠单抗通过国家谈判降价超90%，单支降幅巨大（年治疗费用从数百万降至约十余万至二十余万元区间）
standard_drugs.cost_source: 国家常规临床用药目录谈判结果及公开报道

standard_drugs.usage_role: 2024年中美欧同步获批的新一代单药口服一线/换药突破疗法（每日2次口服）
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 2024年底通过国家谈判大幅降价纳入目录，可及性显著提升

non_drug_therapies_zh: 启动任何补体抑制剂治疗前至少2周，必须接种脑膜炎球菌疫苗（ACYW135群及B群，伊普可泮等近端抑制剂还需接种肺炎球菌和Hib疫苗）预防致命性脑膜炎球菌败血症！
日常避坑：避免剧烈劳累、受凉感染、酸中毒及脱水；明确告知患者PNH为后天体细胞突变，不会遗传给下一代
定期流式细胞术（FLAER）监测PNH克隆比例、LDH、网织红细胞及肾功能；合并重型再障者评估异基因造血干细胞移植
clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 传统输血激素对症年费用约10,000–30,000元（但无法防血栓猝死）；依库珠单抗、可伐利单抗及伊普可泮经国家谈判大幅降价后，患者实际自付负担较过去数百万元天价已呈数量级下降。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: PNH进入“全口服靶向时代”：1) 口服B因子抑制剂Iptacopan在APPLY-PNH与APPOINT-PNH III期试验中使95%以上患者无需输血且血红蛋白恢复正常（彻底解决C5抑制剂残留血管外溶血痛点），并于2024年在中国获批及谈判降价; 2) 口服D因子抑制剂Danicopan联合C5、皮下每4周一次C5单抗Crovalimab（COMMODORE 1/2/3，中国深度参与）均已获批。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 补体抑制剂虽大幅降价但仍需终生维持用药，缺乏可普遍安全根治PNH克隆的方法; 2) 基层医院极易将PNH误诊为普通缺铁性贫血、肾炎或肝硬化腹水（布-加综合征），平均确诊延误数月甚至数年; 3) 脑膜炎球菌B群疫苗在国内可及性仍需配套完善以保障补体抑制剂用药安全。

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
